preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 2000.
For each test case, n must be between 1 and 2000, a must be between 1 and n, and b must be between 1 and the minimum of 26 and a.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, a, b in test_cases) <= 2000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain t lines, each with a string of length n followed by a newline.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n and all(len(set(s[i:i+a])) == b for i in range(n - a + 1)) for s in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output string s must have length n and each substring of length a must contain exactly b distinct letters.
